```sql
-- name: top_customers
-- owner: sales
-- params: tenant_id, from, to, limit
-- Customers ranked by revenue, with their most recent order. Only customers
-- whose last order falls inside the window are listed; this is what the
-- account managers asked for ("who was active this quarter").
WITH cust AS (
    SELECT c.id,
           c.email,
           c.company,
           c.country_code
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
),
agg AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)           AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
      JOIN cust c ON c.id = o.customer_id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       a.revenue,
       a.order_count,
       a.last_order_at
  FROM cust c
  JOIN agg a ON a.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE a.last_order_at >= %(from)s
   AND a.last_order_at <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY a.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De originele query aggregeerde eerst alle orders van alle tenants en joinde daarna pas op de klanten van één tenant. In de herschrijving wordt eerst gefilterd op `tenant_id`, en worden alleen de orders van die klanten geaggregeerd, waarbij `max(created_at)` dezelfde waarde oplevert als de `DISTINCT ON`-subquery. Het resultaat blijft gelijk, inclusief kolommen, filters en de `ORDER BY` van het origineel.
